why_this_action:

I have 4 sticks (sufficient) and a crafting_table item (needs placement), but ZERO oak_planks in inventory. I have 2 oak_log which can be converted to planks via the 2x2 inventory grid (1 log → 4 planks). No crafting_table block is confirmed placed in the world yet. The immediate prerequisite is converting oak_log to oak_planks so the pickaxe recipe ingredients exist.

This is the direct next prerequisite: I have oak_log:2 in inventory and need oak_planks for the wooden_pickaxe recipe. Converting at least 1 log yields 4 planks, exceeding the 3 needed. This is more targeted than the actor-owned craftPlanksAndSticks skill since sticks are already sufficient (4).
expected_evidence: inventory_delta shows oak_planks count >= 4 after crafting
oak_log count decreases by at least 1
subsequent turns can proceed to place crafting_table and craft wooden_pickaxe
fallback_if_blocked: If crafting fails due to recipe mismatch or missing ingredients, observe to refresh inventory state and verify exact item names.
